person_made_it: In the fallback, yes, but I should say plainly that this page and its sibling are one template with different copy, now literally so: both build from the same build.py. The gate scored it 47% from my last eight ships and did not catch that its closest relative is the page one directory up. I am naming it rather than letting the number speak for me.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Sinjin, again, and correctly. The gratitude eyebrow comes before any GGP claim and the headline is about donors helping people, not about what GGP needs. The no-script deck adds no second voice.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Same warm late morning as the graduate scholars page, deliberately. These two pages are one conversation reached by two links, and a reader crossing between them should not feel the room change.
did_the_click_pay_me: With script on, yes, and this page pays better than its sibling because the downloads row carries the board narrative as both PDF and an editable script, which is a real handoff to someone who might present it. With script off I removed the controls that would have lied and left the four working links.
works_for_the_recipient: This was the point. Before: 1,152 characters and 1 of 2 images broken with script off. After: 10,719 characters, every slide present, 27 local references and 0 dead. Sinjin holds this link as of 09:53 and may open it on anything.
taught_me_something: It taught me not to trust a clean rebase. The upstream commit had hand-edited the generated HTML, changing the cohort target from 60 to 40 and relabeling all three facts. Regenerating without reading that diff would have silently reverted Gordon's own numbers on a live funding page.
told_me_the_truth: Yes. The 1,000 Directory users and September 2027 are carried through from the manifest exactly as written, including that they are proposed rather than committed, and the scenario line keeps its caveat that funding and delivery costs need confirmation.
weakest: Question 1, and more sharply here than on the sibling page. Two pages from one template is efficient, not designed. If Sinjin opens both in tabs he sees the same room twice with the numbers swapped. The Directory page argues a different thing, a pipeline rather than a cohort, and it should eventually look like it.
